summary.text: Jake Johnson is the Democratic nominee in Minnesota's 1st District and a high school math teacher in Rochester. According to his campaign website, he is running to lower costs, take on corruption and invest in small towns.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, grew up in Stewartville, Minnesota, with ten siblings, the son of a garbage collector and a meter reader.
Graduated from Stewartville High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse in 2006.
Has taught high school math in Rochester for about 20 years, according to his campaign website.
Has worked as a government relations coordinator and served on the board of the Minnesota Jump$tart Coalition, which promotes financial literacy among young people.
Won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for Minnesota's 1st District, defeating Alex Eaton.
According to his campaign website, he has held 21 in-person town halls, one in each county of the district.
Lives in Southern Minnesota with his wife Molly, a paraprofessional, and their four sons, according to his campaign website.
